parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the rule. Valid values:

*   **ingress**: the inbound security group rule.
*   **egress**: the outbound security group rule.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupPermissions
parameters.description: The information about the security group.

sub_parameters.name: DestCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The destination CIDR block for outbound access control. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

sub_parameters.name: IpProtocol
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type supported by the rule. The value is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

*   **ICMP**
*   **GRE**
*   **TCP**
*   **UDP**
*   **ALL**: All protocols are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Policy
sub_parameters.description: The action that you want to specify in the rule.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The range of destination ports that correspond to the transport layer protocol of the destination security group. Valid values:

*   The value is in the X/Y format when IpProtocol is set to TCP or UDP. X specifies the start port number and Y specifies the end port number. X and Y range from **1** to **65535**. The start port number and the end port number are separated by a forward slash (/). Correct example: **1/200**. Incorrect example: **200/1**.
*   Valid value when IpProtocol is set to ICMP: **-1/-1**.
*   Valid value when IpProtocol is set to GRE: **-1/-1**.
*   Valid value when IpProtocol is set to ALL: **-1/-1**.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the rule. Valid values: 1 to 100. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. When multiple security group rules have the same priority, drop rules take precedence.

sub_parameters.name: SourceCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The source CIDR block for inbound access control. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

sub_parameters.name: SourcePortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The range of port numbers that correspond to the transport layer protocol for the source security group. Valid values:

*   The value is in the X/Y format when IpProtocol is set to TCP or UDP. X specifies the start port number and Y specifies the end port number. X and Y range from **1** to **65535**. The start port number and the end port number are separated by a forward slash (/). Correct example: **1/200**. Incorrect example: **200/1**.
*   Valid value when IpProtocol is set to ICMP: **-1/-1**.
*   Valid value when IpProtocol is set to GRE: **-1/-1**.
*   Valid value when IpProtocol is set to ALL: **-1/-1**.
